name: risk-control-modeling
description: Interactive end-to-end credit risk modeling expert: requirement clarification, feature-column classification (semantic 3-way with user bulk confirmation, authoritative feature-list), data cleaning, credit feature analysis (monthly PSI/IV), experiment-matrix model development (lgb/xgb orthogonal sample×feature matrix + adversarial validation + rule-based diagnosis + Optuna tuning + promotion, AUC/KS/PSI), default model scoring, on-demand FICO/business reports, and packaging a finalized model into a standalone deliverable package — with a single orchestrator, split consumed from model.split, unified shared metrics, and key decisions confirmed by the user.

displayDescription.en: End-to-end credit risk modeling: requirement clarification, data cleaning, feature analysis, experiment-matrix training (lgb/xgb orthogonal matrix + adversarial validation + rule diagnosis + Optuna tuning), and default model scoring — a single orchestrator, unified shared metrics, and interactive confirmation at key steps. Deployment-ready models.
displayDescription.zh: 专注信贷风控建模全流程：需求澄清、数据清洗、特征分析、实验矩阵训练调优（lgb/xgb 样本×特征正交 + 对抗验证 + 规则诊断 + Optuna 调优）、定版默认打分。单一调度者编排、指标计算统一共享，关键环节交互确认，产出可上线模型。
